decision: Selected the place coordinates of the Google Maps address place for Rodovia Presidente Dutra, 4648, Jardim Jose Bonifacio, Sao Joao de Meriti, that ODATA's own RJ01 facility page links, as the campus locator of DC RJ01.

selected_properties.operator_address: Rodovia Presidente Dutra, 4.648 - Jardim Jose Bonifacio, Sao Joao de Meriti - RJ

identity_bridge: ODATA Brazil locations page (version 2026-09-25) lists Data Center RJ01 at the operator address above.

ODATA's archived DC RJ01 facility page (Internet Archive, 16 September 2026) links its 'Acesse o mapa' control to the Google Maps place with feature 0x9964e540dbaf29:0x31ce9a9224bd81f and !3d-22.7970056 !4d-43.3575801.
The Google Maps place capture of 22 October 2026 echoes the same place coordinates in its payload.

consistency_checks.coordinate_order: Google !3d is latitude and !4d is longitude; stored as GeoJSON [lon, lat]
consistency_checks.datum: not stated (web map; WGS 84 assumed by the map service, not asserted by the operator)
consistency_checks.imagery_check: Esri World Imagery export centred on the point (captured 22 October 2026, local esri-odata-rj01.png) shows the point on a flat-roofed building with rooftop plant on the north side of the Dutra highway, next to large logistics sheds; visual plausibility only, and whether the plant-roofed building is ODATA RJ01 or a neighbour is not independently established.
consistency_checks.official_address_point_check: not performed: no Brazilian official address-point service was used
consistency_checks.distance_script: py/geod.py (pyproj 3.7.1 Geod WGS84) in the br-p1 fragment directory
